newsitem.title: INDIA: Gujral poised to name deputies in foreign ministry.
newsitem.headline: Gujral poised to name deputies in foreign ministry.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral is poised to name two deputy foreign ministers, one of his government colleagues said on Monday.
Saleem Iqbal Shervani, the minister of state for health and family welfare, told reporters he expected to be named by Gujral as the new minister of state for external affairs later on Monday.

"I am likely to be given the external affairs portfolio, and Mrs Kamala Sinha is likely to there with me," Shervani said. Sinha was one of four women sworn in as ministers last week who are yet to be assigned specific responsibilities.
Gujral, who took office as prime minister on April 21, continues to hold the foreign affairs portfolio. He currently has no deputies for that role.
Shervani currently holds sole charge of the Health Ministry. It was not immediately clear who would be named to head the Health Ministry.
